identity.name: Occupational Series
identity.definition: A four-digit OPM classification code that groups federal positions by occupation type.

structure.evidence: seriesCode, seriesName, payPlan, grade range, typicalDuties, activeListingCount — sufficient for a detail page.

instances.evidence: IT Management (2210); Miscellaneous Administration and Program (0301); Border Patrol Agent (1896).

purpose.evidence: Job seekers browse by series to find all open positions of a given occupation type across agencies.

sipValidation.verdict: Valid object. Distinct classification with structure, named instances, and a clear navigation purpose.

synonyms.context: Federal HR practitioners and job listings
synonyms.notes: Shortened form of Occupational Series. Common in API fields and HR documentation.
Emphasizes that the code is defined and maintained by OPM.

attributes.name: seriesName
attributes.description: The full name of the occupational series as defined by OPM.

attributes.name: payPlan
attributes.description: The pay plan that applies to this series.

attributes.name: minimumGrade
attributes.description: The lowest grade level typically offered for this series.

attributes.name: maximumGrade
attributes.description: The highest grade level typically offered for this series.

attributes.name: typicalDuties
attributes.description: A general description of the occupation's responsibilities, drawn from OPM classification standards.

attributes.name: activeListingCount
attributes.description: Count of currently open Job Listings in this series. Computed at query time.

actions.name: Browse series listings
actions.description: Navigates to a filtered list of open Job Listings in this occupational series.

actions.name: Follow series
actions.description: Subscribes to notifications when new listings are posted in this series.

actions.name: Share series page
actions.description: Copies or shares a direct URL to the series page.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Job Listings carry a series code that maps to this Occupational Series object.
relationships.cardinality: one-to-many (one Occupational Series has many Job Listings; popular series such as 2210 may have thousands of active listings)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: salary descending, grade descending, closeDate ascending.
relationships.filters: Agency, location, grade, appointment type, telework eligibility.
relationships.dependencies: Optional for Occupational Series. A series can exist with zero active listings. Listings always retain their series code.

relationships.mechanics: Derived. The set of agencies posting listings in this series determines the association.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-many (one series spans many agencies; one agency hires across many series)
relationships.dependencies: Optional. The relationship dissolves if an agency posts no listings in this series.

relationships.mechanics: Derived. The grade range of active listings in this series determines the associated salary ranges.
relationships.cardinality: one-to-many (one Occupational Series spans multiple grade levels, each with a Salary Range)
relationships.dependencies: Optional. Salary ranges are linked through active listings, not directly to the series.

views.context: An Occupational Series in a browse or search context.
views.userIntent: Find the series that matches their occupation or career interest.

views.context: An Occupational Series detail page visited by a job seeker.
views.userIntent: Understand what the occupation involves and browse open positions.

stories.title: Job seeker discovers all open IT positions across government
stories.benefit: finds all open positions in their field without knowing which agencies are hiring
stories.whenClause: When a job seeker knows their occupation type but not which agency to target
stories.thenClause: They see all active listings for that series across all agencies and locations

businessRules.title: Series codes are OPM-defined
businessRules.description: Series codes are maintained by OPM. The redesign does not create or modify series codes.

businessRules.title: Grade range is typical, not binding
businessRules.description: minimumGrade and maximumGrade reflect the typical range for this series. Individual listings may advertise grades outside this range.

businessRules.title: typicalDuties may be absent
businessRules.description: typicalDuties is manually curated from OPM classification standards. It will not be available for all series on launch. The detail page must degrade gracefully.

states.name: Active
states.description: The series is in current use by OPM and agencies.
states.triggers: Series is included in OPM classification standards.

states.name: Deprecated
states.description: The series has been retired or replaced by OPM.
